run_unittest_suite: run a lit test suite loaded from a given input path using unittest.TextTestRunner
load_test_suite: load a test suite from a directory or file path using lit.discovery.load_test_suite
create_test_runner: create a unittest.TextTestRunner with verbosity=2 to print detailed test output
test_lit_unittest_adaptor: test the lit unittest adaptor script by passing an input path as a command line argument
review_lit_discovery_api: review the lit.discovery.load_test_suite API for converting lit tests into unittest suites
